title: pyrola rotundifolia subsp. maritima
intro: Pyrola rotundifolia subsp. maritima, commonly known as Sea Pyrola or Wintergreen, is a plant species belonging to the Pyrolaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Pyrola rotundifolia subsp. maritima include its ability to stimulate digestion, calm the nervous system, and exhibit anti-arthritic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include methyl salicylate, salicylic acid, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
